column1: # Pinned, checksummed ffmpeg builds that TubeGlass bundles in its release packages and downloads
# on first run when no ffmpeg is installed. One gzip-compressed executable per platform.
# Read by the app (src/library/ffmpeg_setup.rs) and by packaging/fetch-ffmpeg.sh.
# To update: change the release tag in the URLs, download each file and refresh the hashes
